subject.title: fix(codex): require explicit final source delivery

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` adopt this explicit `final` runtime contract and supporting Plugin SDK seam, or should OpenClaw use the narrower prompt-only alternative?
rationale: Both approaches address the same bug, but this branch creates durable model-facing and plugin-facing APIs whose permanence cannot be decided from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Adopt explicit final
options.body: Approve the runtime-enforced contract, deliberately align or narrow the SDK seam, and require exact-head live proof.

options.title: Prefer prompt-only
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100156 and avoid adding the new completion and SDK contracts.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit final
recommendation.body: Approve the runtime-enforced contract, deliberately align or narrow the SDK seam, and require exact-head live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed contract directly refines the terminal-delivery behavior introduced in their merged predecessor.
